Final notebook to have the figure from the report


```{r include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(arrow)
library(lubridate)
library(estimatr)
library(stargazer)

Sys.setenv(lang = "en_US")
```


```{r}
save_path_esp <- 'C:/Users/DBT3KD/Desktop/Etude_macro_elec/prix_electricite_gitlab/Intra_day_instrumnet_motivation/outputs'
setwd(save_path_esp)

first_stage_data <- read_parquet('first_stage_data.parquet')

renewable_forecasts <- read_parquet('renewable_forecasts.parquet')

first_stage_combined <- left_join(first_stage_data %>% select(-c('gen_tot', 'gen_uncontrolled')),renewable_forecasts, 
      by = c('datetime' = '__index_level_0__'))

my_fields <- c('gen_tot', 'gen_uncontrolled', 
  'Unavailable.Capacity', 
  'real_unavailability', 
  'intraday_update_renewables', 
   'predicted_real_unavailability', 
   'unexpected_renewables',
  "Solar" ,"Wind Onshore","Wind Offshore","Hydro Run-of-river and poundage"
  )

first_stage_combined <- first_stage_combined %>%
  filter(is.finite(log_price_diff) & 
           is.finite(Unavailable.Capacity))%>% 
   mutate(across(all_of(my_fields), 
                ~ . / 1000))

# create unique creneau auction code for clustering
first_stage_combined$idcode <- as.character(paste(first_stage_combined$creneau,
                  first_stage_combined$auction_before ))

first_stage_combined$predicted_real_unavailability <- -first_stage_combined$predicted_real_unavailability
  
first_stage_combined_5 <- first_stage_combined %>% 
    filter(auction_before == 5)
```


Complete models that include plant unavailabilities as well as the renewable based instrument
```{r}
head(first_stage_combined,5)
colnames(first_stage_combined)
```
First give one example with different specifications


```{r}

# perform first stage regression
m_basic <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ real_unavailability +gen_uncontrolled +unexpected_renewables + gen_tot,
  data= first_stage_combined)

# dummy for creneau

m_creneau <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ real_unavailability +gen_uncontrolled +unexpected_renewables + gen_tot + creneau ,
  data= first_stage_combined)

# use controls
# put a dummy for the number of the auction
# put a dummy for the creneau

# warning cannot put a dummy for date + creneau + auction
# full determination, no variation
m_control <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ real_unavailability +gen_uncontrolled +unexpected_renewables + gen_tot+
    creneau + factor(auction_before),
  data= first_stage_combined)

```

Interpretation
for the basic model,
for a given unavailability of 1 percentage point,
the electricity price increases by 0.9 %



```{r, results = 'asis'}
# Create LaTeX code with regression results
reg_table <- stargazer(m_basic, m_creneau, m_control, 
    type = "html",
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("Basic", "Date FE", "Timeslot FE", 'Timeslot + Auction FE'),
    keep = c('Constant', 'unexpected_renewables','real_unavailability', 'gen_uncontrolled', 'gen_tot')
 )
```


Compare the different unavailability shocks


```{r}
m_unavail <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Unavailable.Capacity +gen_uncontrolled +unexpected_renewables + gen_tot+
    creneau + factor(auction_before),
  data= first_stage_combined)

m_real_unavail <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ real_unavailability +gen_uncontrolled +unexpected_renewables + gen_tot+
    creneau + factor(auction_before),
  data= first_stage_combined)

m_pred_real_unavail <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ predicted_real_unavailability  + gen_uncontrolled +unexpected_renewables + gen_tot+
    creneau + factor(auction_before),
  data= first_stage_combined)

m_share <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Unavailable.Share+gen_uncontrolled +unexpected_renewables + gen_tot+
    creneau + factor(auction_before),
  data= first_stage_combined)

```


```{r, results = 'asis'}
# Create LaTeX code with regression results
reg_unavailability <- stargazer(m_unavail, m_real_unavail, 
                                m_pred_real_unavail, m_share,
    type = "html",
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("Unavailability", "Active", "RF predicted", 'Share'),
    keep = c('Constant', 'unexpected_renewables','Unavailable.Capacity','real_unavailability',
             'predicted_real_unavailability', 'Unavailable.Share', 
             'gen_uncontrolled', 'gen_tot'),
    order = c('Constant', 'unexpected_renewables', 'Unavailable.Capacity', 'real_unavailability',
              'predicted_real_unavailability', 'Unavailable.Share', 
              'gen_uncontrolled', 'gen_tot')
 )
```

Use the revision of the forecast as an instrument

```{r}
# perform first stage regression
m_intraday_information_shock <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ real_unavailability + intraday_update_renewables 
  +gen_uncontrolled  + gen_tot,
  data= first_stage_combined_5 )

m_intraday_control <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ real_unavailability + intraday_update_renewables 
  +gen_uncontrolled +unexpected_renewables + gen_tot + factor(creneau),
  data= first_stage_combined_5 )

m_intraday_without_renew <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ intraday_update_renewables + real_unavailability + gen_tot + factor(creneau),
  data= first_stage_combined_5 )

```


```{r, results = 'asis'}
# Create LaTeX code with regression results
reg_intraday <- stargazer(m_intraday_information_shock, m_intraday_control, 
                                m_intraday_without_renew,
    type = "html",
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("Intraday Revision", "FE", "without renewables"),
    keep = c('Constant', 'unexpected_renewables','real_unavailability','intraday_update_renewables', 'gen_uncontrolled', 'gen_tot')
 )
```
Disentangle which of the few instruments I have for supply are driving the relevance of my gen_uncontrolled instrument

```{r}
first_stage_combined$price <- as.numeric(first_stage_combined$price)
# perform first stage regression
m_renewables <- lm(
  log(price) ~ Solar + `Wind Onshore`+ `Hydro Run-of-river and poundage`,
  data= first_stage_combined)

m_renewables_FE <- lm(
  log(price) ~ Solar + `Wind Onshore` + `Hydro Run-of-river and poundage` + gen_tot + factor(creneau),
  data= first_stage_combined )

```


```{r, results = 'asis'}
# Create LaTeX code with regression results
reg_renewables <- stargazer(m_renewables, m_renewables_FE,
    type = "html",
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("Intraday Revision", "FE", "without renewables"),
    keep = c('Constant','Solar','Wind Onshore', 'Hydro Run-of-river and poundage', 'unexpected_renewables','real_unavailability','intraday_update_renewables', 'gen_uncontrolled', 'gen_tot')
 )
```
